title: Check eligibility asks aMember once per unsuppressed recipient, page by page, stores allow/none/unknown with no address, and the screen loops pages and shows the totals
steps: Run the eligibility suite against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL) with a fake aMember, and the mounted harness flow suite, from this branch.
expect: Without AMEMBER_API_KEY the check answers REAL_MEMBER_CHECK_OFF and makes no request.
Pages of 3 then 1 cover the 4 unsuppressed recipients; the suppressed one is never asked; nextCursor ends null.
Answers are stored as allow 1, none 2 (expired plan and no account), unknown 1 with reason HTTP_502; no stored row contains an address; a second pass replaces rows instead of adding.
The Overview card sends cursors null, c1, c2 with limit 50 and then shows 100 with an active plan, 15 without, 5 not answered, of 120 checked.
fence: Fake aMember only; no credential, no customer address. Private PostgreSQL and a temporary key vault.

tests: Check eligibility asks aMember once per unsuppressed recipient, page by page, and keeps no address
Check eligibility asks page after page until done, then shows the stored answers
